s.g: (Hinduism) The knowledge, acquired through meditation, that one's self (atman) is identical with Ultimate Reality (Brahman).
(Buddhism) Pure awareness that is free of conceptual encumbrances.
Just-noticeable difference, the amount by which something must be changed in order for it to be detectable at least 50% of the time.
s.x: Aleah's nosejob was not dramatic. It was more like a JND, around half her friends noticed it and the other half did not.

jns.f: (skiing, snowboarding) Abbreviation of jump not scored (a score on a scoresheet, for an insufficient/incomplete judged jump).
